metadata.title: A systematic catalogue of real 3D close encounters between numbered asteroids during the Gaia DR3 window
metadata.description: Catalogue of 72,236,904 real three-dimensional close-encounter pairs (minimum separation < 0.05 AU) between numbered asteroids over the Gaia DR3 observation window (2014-07-25 to 2017-05-28), with a measured completeness budget. Files: (1) encounters_catalog_rebound_005au.parquet (Kepler-refined candidate catalogue, 72,236,904 rows, SHA-256 prefix b0272be7...); (2) encounters_catalog_hybrid_stageb.parquet (hybrid catalogue with per-row refinement_method in {kepler, nbody} and both Kepler and N-body distances/epochs/velocities for the dynamically fragile subset); (3) encounters_characterized_full.parquet (adds observability, solar elongation, magnitudes, diameters, taxonomic classes for all rows). Orbits propagated from a single frozen MPCORB snapshot (MPCORB_20160217.DAT, SHA-256 prefix 3e44e7d3...). Provenance sidecar records the MPCORB hash, frozen configuration, and pipeline parameters. Companion paper submitted to Astronomy & Astrophysics.

metadata.notes: MPCORB is a living file; results are not bit-reproducible across snapshot versions. Anything derived from the catalogue must cite both the catalogue SHA (b0272be7...) and the code commit at generation time.
